debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stochastic, Williams %R) combined with fear-zone sentiment (33/100) and proximity to support (69.95) create a classic contrarian bounce setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Confirmed downtrend structure (EMA 50/200 death cross, price below all moving averages, three black crows, ADX bearish) with zero fundamental catalysts, elevated earnings risk in 63 days, and macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) make this a trap bounce in a structurally broken stock.
